Self Health Monitor v1.0.0

- Initial release of the self-health-monitor skill.
- Periodically checks its own operational status, including PCEC execution, memory usage, sub-agent activity, and response quality.
- Automatically generates health reports and sends alerts for abnormal states.
- No user input required; triggers checks every 30 minutes.
- Actively reports own state and attempts self-recovery if issues are detected.
